{{Top|leg}}
'''Rysais Producers Co-operative''' was a large [[rysais]]-producing agricultural co-operative on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. 

The [[city/Legends|city]]-like complex was located south of the [[capital/Legends|capital]] [[Tal'cara]], at the feet of the [[Ragnook Mountains]]. The area had been deforested, and the nearby mountains had been terraced to support huge [[Farm/Legends|farm fields]]. Other than a few thousands of workers, most being were [[droid/Legends|droids]] and other machinery.

Its manager was [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Director of Agriculture]] [[Thanek]], under the [[Consul of Natural Resources]] of the [[Bothan Colonial Board]].

Despite their large production quantities, the co-operative made very little profit and had to rely on government subsidization. This was because rysais was an essential [[foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] for the colony.
